name: RhythmClient
tagline: Separate lane keybinds and spectator audio for the RhythmCraft rhythm-game server.
description: RhythmClient is the optional companion mod for the **RhythmCraft** rhythm-game server (a Guitar-Hero-style game played on the hotbar). The server works without it; the mod makes it nicer to play and to watch.

list: **Separate lane keybinds:** four dedicated keys (default: the arrow keys) for the four lanes, so you can keep your normal hotbar keys for PvP. Set them in Options > Controls > Key Binds > RhythmClient. Pressing one never changes the hotbar slot you have selected.
**Low input lag:** a lane press is sent the instant the key event arrives, not at the next client tick, which removes 0-50 ms of delay from every press.
**Spectator audio:** when you `/spectate` someone, you hear the song from the point they are at. Without the mod spectators hear nothing.

**Make Songs Clean:** switch it on in the server's settings menu and every swear word and slur in a song is cut out of the audio and replaced by a bleep (a Minecraft sound, pitched to the song's tempo), and starred out of your lyrics. Only works with this mod installed.
**Key hints:** the key names shown on the pads and in menus show your lane keys while the mod is active.
Only acts on the RhythmCraft stage world, and not while a menu is open. Players without the mod can still play with hotbar keys 1-4.
Needs Fabric Loader 0.18+ and the Fabric API. Client-side only: nothing to install on the server.
If a lane key is also one of your hotbar keys, only the hotbar key sends the press, so there are no double hits.
Settings are in `config/rhythmclient.json` (the stage world name, `alwaysActive`, and the hotbar slots the server expects for each lane).
Each download covers one Minecraft version (1.21.11, 26.1.x, 26.2 or 26.3); pick your version and the site gives you the right file.

changelog: New: Make Songs Clean - cuts swear words and slurs out of songs and plays a bleep instead (switch it on in the server's settings menu)
Spectator audio and the other 1.2 features are unchanged
Pressing a lane key no longer leaves the server on a different hotbar slot than the one you have selected
First release: four lane keybinds separate from the hotbar keys
Lane presses are sent straight from the key event for the lowest input lag
Spectators hear the song from where the watched player is
